declared_slo.justification: Hospital TPA desk decision cycle requires coverage triage within seconds without manual backlog.

responsible_bottleneck: Local CPU & embedding vector indexing queue
worker_scaling_effects: Scaling agent workers from 1 to 3 under Docker Compose increases throughput from ~2.4 RPS to ~6.8 RPS. Beyond 15 concurrent workers on single CPU core, SQLite write serialization and FAISS index lock become the primary bottleneck.

caching_effects.conclusion: Caching embeddings and previous verified clauses cuts p95 by ~85% and eliminates repeat model token costs.
